intro_card.title: Voz Passiva (Passive Voice)
intro_card.explanation: A voz passiva é usada quando o foco está na ação, não em quem a faz. Muito comum em textos formais, notícias e contextos científicos.
examples: The report was written by the team.

items.content_pt: O relatório foi escrito pela equipe.
items.content_en: The report was written by the team.

options: The report was written by the team.
The report wrote by the team.
The report was wrote by the team.
The report is written by the team.
exercises.correct_answer: The report was written by the team.
The report was written by the team.

items.content_pt: Inglês é falado no mundo inteiro.

options: English is spoken worldwide.
English is speaking worldwide.
English speaks worldwide.
English was spoken worldwide.
exercises.correct_answer: English is spoken worldwide.
English is spoken worldwide.

items.hint: Was + past participle; sem agente quando não importa quem fez

The meeting was canceled.

options: The rules must be followed.

options: The building is being renovated.
